questions.question: What is the primary concern of the 'obtain/build' value chain activity?

options.A: To ensure that service components are available when and where they are needed
options.B: To ensure a shared understanding of the vision and improvement direction
options.C: To meet stakeholder expectations for quality, cost, and time to market
options.D: To provide services to agreed specifications and support their consumption

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "To ensure that service components are available when and where they are needed". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.74 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends that you should make information visible and promote collaboration?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Collaborate and promote visibility". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.59 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is a major risk of organizational silos?

options.A: They increase collaboration between different departments
options.B: They lead to fragmented workflows, lack of transparency, and poor end-to-end communication
options.C: They automatically reduce the cost of service consumption
options.D: They replace the need for the four dimensions of service management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "They lead to fragmented workflows, lack of transparency, and poor end-to-end communication". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.47 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which practice involves tracking the performance of external vendors?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Supplier management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.115 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the relationship between the service value chain and value streams?

options.A: They are completely independent systems that do not interact
options.B: Value streams are specific combinations of activities and practices that flow through the service value chain
options.C: Value streams replace the service value chain in modern organizations
options.D: The service value chain is a single value stream designed by the customer

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Value streams are specific combinations of activities and practices that flow through the service value chain". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.69 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which is an example of an operational metric in service level management?

options.C: The number of business transactions completed
options.D: The total revenue generated by the service

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "System uptime percentage". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.165 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'IT asset management' practice?

options.A: To move hardware and software to live environments
options.B: To plan and manage the full lifecycle of all IT assets to help the organization maximize value, control costs, and manage risks
options.D: To set clear business-based targets for service levels

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To plan and manage the full lifecycle of all IT assets to help the organization maximize value, control costs, and manage risks". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.108 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What describes a change of state that has significance for the management of an IT service?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Event". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.138 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which role represents the person who uses the services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "User". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.21 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: What is co-created when service providers and consumers work together?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Value". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.19 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends that you should focus on simplicity first?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Keep it simple and practical". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.63 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the purpose of 'continual improvement'?

options.B: To align the organization's practices and services with changing business needs through the ongoing identification and improvement of services

questions.question: What is the definition of an incident?

options.A: A cause of one or more incidents
options.B: An unplanned interruption or reduction in the quality of a service

options.D: A change of state that has significance for service management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "An unplanned interruption or reduction in the quality of a service". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.201 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice is responsible for assessing and prioritizing changes?

questions.question: What is a workaround in incident management?

options.A: A permanent resolution of a bug

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A temporary solution that reduces or eliminates the impact of an incident or problem". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is a key activity of problem management?

options.A: Restoring service operations as quickly as possible
options.B: Identifying actual and potential causes of incidents
options.D: Moving software components to live environments

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Identifying actual and potential causes of incidents". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice provides a single point of contact for users?

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "To help plan, schedule, and avoid conflicts when implementing changes". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.130 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice has a purpose that includes setting clear business-based targets for service level performance?

questions.question: What is the primary concern of the 'obtain/build' value chain activity?

options.A: To ensure that service components are available when and where they are needed
options.B: To ensure a shared understanding of the vision and improvement direction
options.C: To meet stakeholder expectations for quality, cost, and time to market
options.D: To provide services to agreed specifications and support their consumption

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "To ensure that service components are available when and where they are needed". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.74 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which guiding principle recommends that you should make information visible and promote collaboration?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Collaborate and promote visibility". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.59 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is a major risk of organizational silos?

options.A: They increase collaboration between different departments
options.B: They lead to fragmented workflows, lack of transparency, and poor end-to-end communication
options.C: They automatically reduce the cost of service consumption
options.D: They replace the need for the four dimensions of service management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "They lead to fragmented workflows, lack of transparency, and poor end-to-end communication". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.47 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which practice involves tracking the performance of external vendors?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Supplier management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.115 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the relationship between the service value chain and value streams?

options.A: They are completely independent systems that do not interact
options.B: Value streams are specific combinations of activities and practices that flow through the service value chain
options.C: Value streams replace the service value chain in modern organizations
options.D: The service value chain is a single value stream designed by the customer

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Value streams are specific combinations of activities and practices that flow through the service value chain". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.69 (CHAPTER 4).
